PENTHOUSE GROOVE NEW DJ VIDEO🎧
【memories of summer 2026】

afro brazilian feat criolo, amaro e dino

This time, we're sharing a transition scene from "Looking Up – Finn Rees" into "E Se Livros Fossem Líquidos_ (Poeta Fora da Lei Pt II) – Criolo, Amaro Freitas & Dino d'Santiago".

From a track that evokes the soft glow of dusk, its warmth lingers as the mood shifts into something more refined and nocturnal. Enjoy these two tracks as the scenery slowly transforms from one into the next.

今回は「LOOKING UP - FINN REES」から「E Se Livros Fossem Líquidos_ (Poeta Fora da Lei Pt II) · Criolo, Amaro Freitas & Dino d'Santiago」への繋ぎのシーンをお届け。
夕暮れの柔らかな光を思わせる一曲から、その温もりをまとったまま、より洗練された夜の気配へ。
ゆっくりと景色が移り変わっていくような二曲をお楽しみください。
